posts.name: Dipshikha Patel
posts.cooked:
Respected Sir/Madam,

Today, I had my SC oppe examination. During the first 10 minutes, my network was stable, but afterward it got disconnected. I informed proctor through the meeting chat that my connection was poor and that my COC was not visible. They told me for rejoin then I immediately recharged an additional data pack and rejoined the meeting. However, the proctor told me that I would not be allowed to continue the exam due to network issue and they removed me from the meeting.

I live in a rural area, where network issues are common and often unavoidable. Due to this network problem, I was removed from the examination, which I believe is unfair.

Kindly guide me on what steps I should take now. I request your support in resolving this matter.
& please reschedule my oppe

Thank you.

@hemalatha
@AtulPS
@Afnan_POD
@sayan @21f3000759 Swati
@Mrinal.exe Mrinal
@22f3000671 Prakhar

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Please read section 23.3 and 23.4 of Student Handbook ( a document every student is supposed to be totally familiar with in order to pursue this degree).

Link.

If you are pursuing an online degree, it is pertinent for you to have proper system requirements.
